apps.name: AstroTools-ADV
apps.tagline: A PyQt5 GUI for the whole astropy and astroquery ecosystem
apps.description: Desktop front-end for astropy: units, constants, time, coordinates, tables, FITS and other I/O, WCS, NDData, convolution, visualization, modeling, statistics, time series, cosmology, SAMP, utilities and astroquery services, plus an API explorer that reaches every public astropy callable. Objects can be passed between tools through a shared workspace.
apps.author: Jan Dubovsky (JapySoft)
